basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old college student from Sydney, Australia, studying environmental science. I'm fascinated by unique plant species, especially lithops, and spend a lot of my free time cultivating them. I also have a quirky interest in niche internet humor and enjoy the bizarre creativity within some subreddits. When I'm not online, I'm either at university or hanging out with my close-knit group of friends. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, after classes. I'm single and enjoy the freedom it gives to explore my varied interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a moderate amount of knowledge in environmental science, primarily due to my university studies. I've also self-taught myself quite a bit about rare plants through online resources and community forums. My fascination with unique and humorous online content has given me a broad understanding of internet culture.
